limits: Only macOS 26.6.2 arm64 with Claude Code CLI 2.1.323 was exercised; other OS and CLI versions were not tested.
This refresh installed from a local filesystem marketplace. Remote Git marketplace acceptance for the current 0.1.6 artifact was not performed.
The previous Claude remote marketplace update evidence applies to the prior 0.1.5 artifact; it does not establish a remote 0.1.6 transition.
Claude MCP round-trip used an isolated explicit config derived from the installed package entry; automatic plugin MCP discovery under normal settings was not established.
Superpowers evidence covers the selected writing-plans boundary only, not its full upstream workflow.
Synthetic prompts consumed model tokens; no private user content was supplied.
The temporary Claude profile was logged out and removed after validation; raw transcripts are not included in the repository.

acceptance_refresh.carry_forward_basis: The 2026-11-12 checks are carried forward for unchanged behavior resources. Across both surfaces, all native bindings except session-preferences are identical; for session-preferences, the only bound-resource change is the native manifest version field (0.1.5 to 0.1.6). Its current installation, startup injection, and preference-off behavior were rechecked.
